ShortDescription.Value: Drag a box over the map, keep only the asset types you ticked, delete them.

Publish.LongDescription:
Bulldozer Marquee adds a box-select bulldozer to Cities: Skylines II. Drag a rectangle over the map, and everything inside it that matches your chosen asset types is highlighted live as you drag. Release to commit the selection, then bulldoze the lot in one go.
## How to use it
1. Click the bulldozer icon in the top-left. The tool takes over the cursor and the filter panel appears in the bottom-left corner — drag its header to move it. 2. Tick the asset categories the marquee is allowed to catch. 3. Drag a box over the map. Everything the box covers is ringed as you drag, and the count updates with it. 4. **Bulldoze** deletes the selection. **Clear** drops the selection without deleting anything.
Right click backs out one step at a time: it cancels an in-progress drag, then clears a selection, then leaves the tool.
## Filters
Trees, props, nodes, segments, buildings, surfaces and net lanes can each be included or excluded independently, so you can clear every tree from an area without touching the roads running through it.
## Options
- **Confirm before bulldozing** — ask before deleting, so a mis-drag costs nothing. - **Keep the selection in sync with the filters** — unticking a filter immediately drops that type out of the selection you already made. - **Play bulldoze sound** — a sound effect on the Bulldoze button.
All three are in Options > Mods > Bulldozer Marquee, and mirrored by checkboxes on the panel itself.
## Notes
The marquee is a real game tool, not a UI overlay, so it respects your own key bindings, cancels whichever tool was active when you start it, and closes on Escape like every vanilla tool. The selection rectangle is drawn as world geometry, so it drapes over terrain instead of floating flat above a hillside.
